description: This file defines a React component for a form to log new defect reports in a quality defect tracking system. It manages form state, handles image uploads as base64, and interacts with local storage and routing to save a new defect entry.

methods.name: todayIsoDate
methods.description: Returns the current date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: NewDefectPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the form to create a new defect report.

methods.name: onFile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a selected image file, converts it to base64 string, and updates the state.
